title: Prove MCP++ authorization and result parity across transports

authority.statement: AuthorizationGate@1 is the sole dispatch gate for protected MCP tools. UCANVerifier@1 with a durable RevocationLedger@1 and ProfileDPolicyProvider@1 admit effects. Stdio, HTTP, and P2P are framing projections of the same JSON-RPC handler and must not reimplement authorization or storage logic.

transport_entrypoints.stdio: server.handle_stdio_line, the JSON-line codec used by serve_stdio
transport_entrypoints.http: Hypercorn asyncio server over an ephemeral loopback TCP socket, posting JSON-RPC to /mcp; e2e additionally launches the production Trio process entrypoint

parity_policy.note: Each transport receives one identical signed request against an independent ledger and Event DAG under a frozen authorization clock. Raw durable decision event CIDs and every Profile B artifact CID must therefore match. Only the namespaced top-level _dispatch tracing object is removed by production Profile B output normalization; top-level and nested domain fields remain content-bound.

adversarial_corpus.missing_envelope: authorization_envelope_required; zero dispatch; identical decision CID
adversarial_corpus.policy_denied: Profile D prohibition yields policy_denied before handler
adversarial_corpus.signed_to_unsigned_downgrade: compact token without signature segment fails on every transport
adversarial_corpus.confused_deputy: UCAN audience bound to deputy DID cannot authorize claiming actor
adversarial_corpus.forged_key: token signed by unregistered private key fails closed
adversarial_corpus.valid_attenuation: signed root-to-service-to-client chain with narrower resource, ability, and request bounds succeeds through every transport
adversarial_corpus.cross_tenant_escalation: leaf capability outside its parent's tenant and wider bounds fails with zero dispatch on every transport
adversarial_corpus.future_nbf: signed token whose not-before time is in the future fails with zero dispatch on every transport
adversarial_corpus.request_bounds: request exceeding or changing capability bounds fails with zero dispatch on every transport
adversarial_corpus.revocation_replay_restart: durable RevocationLedger preserves replay and revocation across process restart for every transport

security_evidence_policy.statement: This conformance report accepts positive security evidence only from UCANVerifier@1 over Ed25519 tokens and a durable RevocationLedger@1. The suite constructs real keys, issues signed UCANs, and asserts the concrete verifier and ledger types; it makes no claim that arbitrary dependency injection cannot install a test verifier.
security_evidence_policy.audit_redaction: Bearer tokens, private_input fields, and signature material must not appear in authorization.decision or authorization.effect audit events.

evidence_subset.transport_decision_parity: Identical denial reason and decision event_cid across stdio, HTTP, and P2P for every adversarial case under a frozen authorization clock.
evidence_subset.transport_result_parity: A real HermeticIPFSFixtureAdapter pin effect produces identical status, content_cid, version, transaction_cid, and every Profile B artifact CID after removing only _dispatch tracing metadata.
evidence_subset.zero_dispatch_on_denial: Dispatch spy remains empty for every denial on every transport.
evidence_subset.attenuation: A valid signed parent-to-leaf attenuation succeeds; cross-tenant escalation, future nbf, and request-bound violations deny with zero dispatch over stdio, Hypercorn HTTP, and P2P.
evidence_subset.restart: Replay of a consumed nonce and use of a revoked token_id both deny after ledger reload.
evidence_subset.no_mock_crypto: All positive evidence in this suite uses concrete UCANVerifier and RevocationLedger instances.
